# Dear ImGui 1.91.8

The launcher's interface. These files come unchanged from the official release
[v1.91.8](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases/tag/v1.91.8) (MIT, see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)):
the core files and the SDL3 and SDL_Renderer 3 backends from `backends/`.

Only the launcher links it. The game itself doesn't use it.
